key_insight: LEAP combines a perovskite-focused LLM with active learning to prioritize precursor additives using mechanism-aware, literature-grounded descriptors.
engineering_relevance: The framework can reduce trial-and-error screening in perovskite solar cell development by guiding additive selection under low-data, uncertainty-aware conditions.
method: Trains a domain-specialized LLM on additive literature to extract mechanism-relevant knowledge.
Encodes candidate molecules with interpretable descriptors for downstream ranking.
Uses Bayesian optimization plus expert feasibility review in a closed-loop screening workflow.
evidence_signal: On unseen literature, the specialized model outperformed general-purpose models in mechanism-consistent reasoning, and the proof-of-concept screening achieved average PCEs of 20.13% and 20.87% in later rounds versus 19.25% for the control, with a best device at 21.32%.
watch_item: The approach still depends on the quality of literature-derived knowledge and expert review, so generalization and practical throughput may be limited by data bias and human-in-the-loop bottlenecks.
paper_title: LEAP: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
